scope: Read-only source review; not benchmark acceptance
findings: Native word forecast covers7 native locales at speed>=3; wide/MMS has no word forecast
Wide/MMS generates the complete native carrier before voice conversion
Existing 256-entry/48MiB exact-word cache does not prove unseen-word latency
Adaptive MMS warm-model limit is7, reduced to2 for unknown/low memory; not a hard3
next_experiment: 100 distinct words per language, cold versus resident-model cache misses versus exact PCM hits
Three-language cycling and four-language eviction pressure with real carrier/conversion/first-PCM/RTF/memory/cancel metrics
constraint: If each unseen word takes longer to synthesize than its spoken duration at the chosen rate, bounded lookahead cannot eliminate sustained gaps. 40ms target remains unchanged.
planned_forecast_safety: one bounded forecast worker and one ready-result slot
separate per-request cancellation context; foreground priority
active-use model lease; epoch/voice/language/control-sensitive final PCM keys
